description.value: Little Pisces is a Japanese-inspired dessert shop specializing in taiyaki — crispy, chewy mochi-batter fish-shaped pastries available in rotating fillings — alongside seasonal soft serve flavors and specialty café drinks. The Richmond location opened in May 2025 as the brand's second outpost, following their original Lougheed store in Burnaby. Dairy-free and vegan options are clearly marked on the menu, with oat milk available for most drinks.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 12m; rack at 27m; rack at 64m.
